title: Ripple Prime Launches 24/7 Institutional Swaps Across 100+ RWA Reference Markets
why_it_matters: The launch connects crypto-native perpetual markets with institutional prime brokerage, cross-margining and stablecoin collateral without representing direct ownership of the referenced assets.
caption:
RWA WIRE // DERIVATIVES

Ripple Prime Launches 24/7 Institutional Swaps Across 100+ RWA Reference Markets

Ripple Prime now offers institutional swaps referencing more than 100 continuous markets across equities, ETFs, metals, energy and foreign exchange.
